content:
The reference image for Sooty Mould (Mango_Leaf_147.jpg) shows dark, irregular, superficial patches on the leaf surface, which strongly resembles the test image. This confirms Sooty Mould as a very strong candidate.

Now, I will view a reference image for Anthracnose to compare.

The reference image for Die_Back (Mango_Leaf_166.jpg) shows a completely dried, shriveled, and brown leaf, which does not match the test image at all. Sooty Mould is still the most visually similar.

Now, I will view a reference image for Powdery_Mildew.

thought
The reference image for Powdery_Mildew (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a leaf covered with white, powdery fungal growth. This is distinctly different from the dark, blackish spots in the test image.

Based on the initial review of one reference image from each class, Sooty Mould is by far the most similar. I have 4 reference image views remaining out of 8. I will use the remaining views to further confirm Sooty Mould and check if there are any other similar visual representations for other diseases, though it seems unlikely.

I will view another Sooty Mould image to reinforce the visual similarity.
5. **Sooty_Mould**: `CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Sooty_Mould/leaf/Mango_Leaf_164.jpg`

Then I will view a second Anthracnose image to be sure.
6. **Anthracnose**: `CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Anthracnose/leaf/Mango_Leaf_383.jpg`

Then a second Die_Back image.
7. **Die_Back**: `CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Die_Back/leaf/Mango_Leaf_444.jpg`

And a second Powdery_Mildew image.
8. **Powdery_Mildew**: `CyberVisionAg/Prepared_Dataset/Mango_Leaf/Powdery_Mildew/leaf/Mango_Leaf_164.jpg`

The second reference image for Sooty Mould (Mango_Leaf_164.jpg) shows a leaf with dark, brownish-black, irregular smudges or patches on the surface. While the exact pattern is slightly different from the test image, the general characteristic of superficial dark deposits is consistent with Sooty Mould.

Now, I will view a second reference image for Anthracnose.

The second reference image for Anthracnose (Mango_Leaf_383.jpg) shows distinct, well-defined, somewhat circular dark brown to black spots with yellowish halos on a green leaf. While these are dark spots, they appear to be lesions within the leaf tissue rather than superficial growth, and the shape and definition of the spots are different from the irregular, more widespread superficial coating in the test image.

Sooty Mould still remains the strongest candidate. I will now view a second Die_Back image.

The second reference image for Die_Back (Mango_Leaf_444.jpg) again shows a completely dried, shriveled, and brown leaf, consistent with the description of leaves rolling upward, turning brown, and dying back. This does not resemble the test image.

Sooty Mould remains the most visually similar. I will now view a second Powdery_Mildew image to complete the required 8 views.
